instruction: The "~/pictures/" directory in my file system has photo files organized in sub-directories for each vacation spot. Compress them and save them in "~/pictures/vacations/<vacation_spot>.zip" for each vacation spot, and then delete all vacation spot sub-directories. Here, <vacation_spot> is the name of the vacation spot as it appears in the sub-directory name.

# List immediate subdirectories under ~/pictures
pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='adrian_burt@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']
spots = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/pictures', entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print('immediate_subdirs:', spots)
print('count:', len(spots))

pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='adrian_burt@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']
subspots = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/pictures/vacations', entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print('spot_dirs:', subspots)
print('count:', len(subspots))

# Compress each vacation spot directory into ~/pictures/vacations/<spot>.zip
pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='adrian_burt@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']
spot_dirs = ['/home/adrian/pictures/vacations/bali/', '/home/adrian/pictures/vacations/maui/', '/home/adrian/pictures/vacations/santorini/', '/home/adrian/pictures/vacations/seoul/']
# derive spot names
spot_names = []
for d in spot_dirs:
    name = d.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]
    spot_names.append(name)
print('spot_names:', spot_names)

compress_results = []
for spot, d in zip(spot_names, spot_dirs):
    zip_path = f'~/pictures/vacations/{spot}.zip'
    # check whether zip already exists
    exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path=zip_path).get('exists')
    print('zip_exists', spot, exists, zip_path)
    r = apis.file_system.compress_directory(
        access_token=fs_token,
        directory_path=d,
        compressed_file_path=zip_path,
        delete_directory=False,
        overwrite=True,
    )
    print('compressed', spot, r)
    # verify zip now exists
    exists_after = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path=zip_path).get('exists')
    print('zip_exists_after', spot, exists_after)
    compress_results.append((spot, zip_path, exists_after))

print('compress_results:', compress_results)
